largest_object.text:
(rule! (lambda (g) (let ((p ((lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define marker-positions
               (filter (lambda (rc) (= (at g (nth rc 0) (nth rc 1)) 1))
                       (apply append
                              (map (lambda (r)
                                     (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range 0 w)))
                                   (range 0 h)))))
             (define rs (map (lambda (rc) (nth rc 0)) marker-positions))
             (define cs (map (lambda (rc) (nth rc 1)) marker-positions))
             (define r1 (min-list rs))
             (define r2 (max-list rs))
             (define c1 (min-list cs))
             (define c2 (max-list cs))
             (define oh (+ (- r2 r1) 1))
             (define ow (+ (- c2 c1) 1))
             (define (get-pixel r c)
               (let* ((cands (list (list r c)
                                   (list r (- (- w 1) c))
                                   (list (- (- h 1) r) c)
                                   (list (- (- h 1) r) (- (- w 1) c))))
                      (vals (map (lambda (rc) (at g (nth rc 0) (nth rc 1))) cands))
                      (good (find (lambda (v) (!= v 1)) vals)))
                 (if good good 1)))
             (build-grid oh ow (i j) (get-pixel (+ r1 i) (+ c1 j)))))) g))) (let ((os (objects p 0))) (if (null? os) '((0)) (let ((o (pick-max os obj-size))) (build-grid (obj-h o) (obj-w o) (r c) (if (member (list (+ (obj-r1 o) r) (+ (obj-c1 o) c)) (obj-cells o)) (at p (+ (obj-r1 o) r) (+ (obj-c1 o) c)) 0))))))))
